name: ViT Image Classifier (Transformer)
description: Forward pass: image to 16 patch tokens to logits

data.noteContent:
A Vision Transformer has no convolutional hierarchy. It cuts the image into fixed tiles, treats each tile as a token, and lets self-attention compare every tile with every other one from the first layer on - where a ConvNet needs depth before two far-apart pixels can meet.

The input is a random tensor: this graph shows the wiring and the shapes, not a trained model. Two pieces of a real ViT are missing: a position embedding, without which this stack cannot tell where a tile came from, and a CLS token, for which Mean pooling stands in. Print is (2, 10).

Vision Transformer 沒有卷積式的階層。它把影像切成固定大小的方塊，每塊當成一個 token，從第一層開始就讓自注意力兩兩比較 — 卷積網路則要疊到夠深，相隔很遠的兩個像素才碰得到面。

輸入是隨機張量：這張圖看的是接線與形狀，不是訓練好的模型。真正的 ViT 少了兩件東西：位置嵌入（少了它，這個堆疊分不出方塊原本在哪裡），以及 CLS token（這裡用 Mean 池化代替）。Print 是 (2, 10)。

A stride-8 Conv2d over a 32x32 image is the patch cut: 16 non-overlapping 8x8 tiles, each projected to 48 dims. The Reshape and Permute after it only change the view, (2,48,4,4) to (16,2,48).

對 32x32 影像做 stride 8 的 Conv2d，就是切 patch：16 個互不重疊的 8x8 方塊，每塊投影成 48 維。後面的 Reshape 和 Permute 只是換一種看法，(2,48,4,4) 變成 (16,2,48)。

Mean over dim 1 averages the 16 patch tokens into one vector, and head turns it into 10 class scores. A ViT with a CLS token reads that one position instead of averaging.

Mean 沿 dim 1 把 16 個 patch token 平均成一個向量，head 再把它變成 10 個類別分數。有 CLS token 的 ViT 則是直接讀那一個位置，不做平均。
